edges.reason: Artificial neural networks are built from neuron-like units, so understanding neurons is necessary to understand their structure.
Autoencoders are neural network architectures, so understanding artificial neural networks is necessary before learning autoencoders.
Autoencoders learn efficient representations of data, so understanding data representation is necessary.
Visual recognition requires understanding how image data is structured and represented for model input.
